lead: Naveen Patnaik is an Indian politician, born on 16 October 1946 in Cuttack.
As of 2026, he is 79 years old, and his birth date places him under the Libra sign.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Odisha and Member of the Fourteenth Odisha Legislative Assembly.
The sections that follow break down Naveen Patnaik's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Naveen Patnaik — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Naveen Patnaik was born on 16 October 1946 in Cuttack, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India.
Public records name his father, Biju Patnaik. He is a sibling of Gita Mehta.
He studied at Kirori Mal College, University of Delhi and Welham Boys' School.
He is recorded as speaking Odia and English.

sections.heading: Naveen Patnaik — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and writer as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Odisha (2000–2024), Member of the Fourteenth Odisha Legislative Assembly (2009–2014), Member of the Fifteenth Odisha Legislative Assembly (2014–present), Member of the Thirteenth Odisha Legislative Assembly (2004–2009), Member of the Twelfth Odisha Legislative Assembly (2000–2004) and Member of the 12th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Biju Janata Dal.
